verdict.rationale: RevenueCat is a SaaS platform that stores customer purchase data and ships AI features (Rico, AI-powered paywall generation), so a training opt-out is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents an opt-out, data-usage policy, or guarantee that customer data is excluded from AI model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
